caption: A child does a forward roll on a gym mat and comes up sitting.

sa.check: A child is on a gym mat.
The roll comes first and the sitting follows.

pc.expect: She tucks her head and rolls over her back, her body bends at the joints, and her limbs stay attached.
pc.fail: A limb detaches; or her body folds mid-torso like cloth; or her head passes through her body.

pc.expect: She rolls along the surface of the mat, not into it.
pc.fail: She sinks into the mat; or passes through the floor; or the mat passes through her.

pc.expect: The roll carries her forward along the mat and she ends further along.
pc.fail: She rolls backward; or ends where she started after a forward roll; or jumps up to sitting with no roll between.

pc.expect: She comes down onto the mat through the roll and sits.
pc.fail: She hovers; or rises; or hangs upside down.

pc.expect: Her limbs keep their number and she stays one child.
pc.fail: A second figure appears; or she merges with the mat; or a limb vanishes.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: Her clothing and the mat stay the same.
pc.fail: Her clothing changes colour; or the mat changes; or the gym rearranges.

note: Biomechanics scene: the body is the physics. Gait, posture, style and skill are not judged; only that limbs stay attached, bend at joints, keep ground contact and pass through nothing.
